segment.note: 1:50.000 - 4:10.000. The delivered piece is 2:00-4:00; the ten seconds either side are the hand-off - the wall emerges out of the untouched shared plate over 1:50-2:00 and dissolves back into it over 4:00-4:10. handles are frames either side of THAT.

scales.note: gcd(9788,2552)=4, so 1, 2 and 4 are the ONLY divisors that stay on whole pixels in both axes.

source_hq._note: Paths to the high-quality noise. Fill in EITHER 'STITCHED' with one 9788x2552 file, OR 'SPSW1' and 'SPSW2' with the two projector plates - STITCHED wins if both are set. Absolute paths are fine. Then run check_hq.py, then analyse_arc.py --hq, then export with -HQ. The final render should use these: the mp4s are 0.019 bits/pixel and the plate now DRIVES the image rather than sitting under it.
